content: We got three templates. Need a retrosynthesis route with 1 reaction. The target SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. This looks like a methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe a bicyclo[4.4.0]dec-1-ene-2-one?). Diels-Alder could be used to form the bicyclic ring. So we need a template that corresponds to a Diels-Alder (retro) i.e., breaking a cyclohexene to diene + dienophile. The search gave a template where retro_smarts_template is [C:1]-[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]-[C:4]>>[C:1]-[CH2;D2;+0:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:3]-[C:4] which is a retro Diels-Alder (break double bond to single bonds). That seems appropriate. Template ID? The result includes reaction_id and template_hash but not template_id. Probably template_id is reaction_id? In other tools, template_id is string. Might be the reaction_id. We'll assume template_id = 264054 (first entry). Need to verify applicability to target. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.
